reporting_policy: Every user-facing project progress output should report at minimum requirements_structure_percent, g1_system_freeze_percent and backlog_done_percent. Broader engineering percentages must be explicitly labeled estimates.

requirements_structure.meaning: Planned requirement-domain hierarchy/schema/authority coverage, not product-value closure.

g1_system_freeze.note: PB-08 freezes the common 12S bus, 36/43.2/50.4 V loaded/nominal/full values, <=75 V repetitive controlled switch-terminal stress target with >=100 V semiconductor class, and per-ESC >=1.0 kW/30 A continuous plus >=1.5 kW/50 A for >=3 s hardware capability. Quad/Hexa, payload/MTOW, exact motor/prop, pack peak current, phase current, PWM, environment and protection remain open. PASS means controlled value closure, not physical verification.

backlog.note: Only the current low-power propulsion market benchmark is explicitly DONE. Battery/ESC tasks advanced materially under PB-08 but remain IN_PROGRESS because exact pack, rotor architecture, phase current, PWM and protection are not closed.

gate_closure.note: G0/G1 remain open because payload/MTOW, rotor architecture, exact propulsion, pack implementation/peak current, phase/PWM/environment/protection/thermal requirements remain unresolved.
